hero_text: We’re the volunteers behind the kennel doors at Forsyth County Animal Shelter, helping shelter stays become second chances.
intro_text:
Every animal that enters FCAS is more than a kennel, a number, and a waiting period. They deserve to be seen, understood, cared for and whenever possible, given a chance to find a second home.

We are a dedicated volunteer-powered nonprofit committed to supporting FCAS and the animals who depend on their care. We bridge the gap between what a shelter can provide and what vulnerable animals truly need.
belief_quote: The shy animal hiding in the back, the frightened one who needs some time to trust, the overlooked senior and those who simply need someone to speak up for them are all worthy.
closing_text: Because every animal deserves better and every community can do more.
